body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> British Wool Marketing Board (www.britishwool.org.uk) launched 'Shades of Nature' at Surfaces 2009 in Las Vegas from Feb.3-5, which is a collection of 100% natural and undyed tufted carpet yarns.
Presenting a completely natural and versatile selection of British Wool breed based and British Wool blended yarns that have been developed to meet the ascending environmental agenda.

Meanwhile, the British Wool Marketing Board represents approximately 58,000 wool producers in the UK. It collects, grades, auctions and promotes approx 35 million kgs of British Wool, from over 60 pure sheep breeds and many half and cross- bred sheep. Over 70% of British Wool is used in the production of carpet and quality manufacturers across the globe particularly regard it as having excellent colour retention, and superior resilience to footfall and tracking. British Wool is annually replenished, sustainable, recyclable and biodegradable.
